display.title: Episode 508: The Stargazer (Parshas Shemos)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi welcomes the new Chumash Shemos with a lesson on living with the weekly parsha, then tells the story of a stargazer whose prediction was undone by a gift of bread.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week Parshas Shemos was read in 5752. Uncle Yossi explains that with Chumash Bereishis finished, a brand new Chumash begins this Shabbos, and recalls the Alter Rebbe's teaching to 'live with the times': learn the weekly parsha and find a living lesson in it for each day. He encourages children to use the many new sefarim on the parsha. After the Hakochainik march, a young Tzivos Hashem soldier recites the Shema in Studio 604 and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time tells of a stargazer who predicts that a young man walking into the forest will not come back alive. When the young man returns safe, the stargazer learns that he had given his bread to a starving old man, and a snake hidden in his sack slipped away. Uncle Yossi teaches from Mishlei that tzedakah saves from death. The show ends with a listener's letter from Uncle Yossi's mailbox and Shabbos candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: Tzedakah saves from death and brings Hashem's blessings; and every week we should find a living lesson in the parsha.

date.note: 'This coming Shabbos we begin Shemos'; candle time 4:17. Episodes 508-516 fit leap year 5752 (Purim Katan on 516).
